# AudioTheory

> Music theory tools for guitar and piano

AudioTheory makes interactive music theory software for guitar and piano — AudioTheory Guitars, Piano Keys and Grids, for Mac, Windows and Linux, sold through Steam, the Mac and iOS App Stores and direct. Each app has a product page, a user guide and its own changelog; the articles below are release notes and announcements.

## Site

- [Home](https://audiotheory.co/): AudioTheory makes revolutionary music theory software for guitar and piano — AudioTheory Guitars, Piano Keys and Grids for Mac, Windows and Linux.
- [Contact](https://audiotheory.co/contact/): Contact AudioTheory — questions about AudioTheory Guitars, Piano Keys or Grids are welcome by email at fraser@audiotheory.co.
- [FAQ](https://audiotheory.co/faq/): Frequently asked questions about AudioTheory software — platforms, updates, left-handed support, 64 bit versions and how to get in touch.
- [AudioTheory Grids Update Log](https://audiotheory.co/grids-update-log/): Every AudioTheory Grids release — new features, changes and fixes, version by version.
- [AudioTheory Guitars Update Log](https://audiotheory.co/guitars-update-log/): Every AudioTheory Guitars release — new features, changes and fixes, version by version.
- [AudioTheory Piano Keys Update Log](https://audiotheory.co/piano-keys-update-log/): Every AudioTheory Piano Keys release — new features, changes and fixes, version by version.
- [Press](https://audiotheory.co/press/): Press enquiries and downloadable asset packs for AudioTheory software — high-res screenshots and logos for AudioTheory Guitars and Grids.
- [Privacy Policy](https://audiotheory.co/privacy/): The AudioTheory privacy policy — what data the audiotheory.co website collects, how it is used, and your rights regarding your personal data.

- [Frame test](https://audiotheory.co/zz-frame-test/): temporary block test page

## Products

- [AudioTheory Grids](https://audiotheory.co/grids/): AudioTheory Grids combines intuitive music theory tools with a grid-based sequencer — program compositions and play them back on piano and fretboard diagrams.
- [AudioTheory Guitars](https://audiotheory.co/guitars/): AudioTheory Guitars is an interactive encyclopaedia for guitar chords, notes and scales — available for Mac, Windows and Linux via Steam, the Mac App Store or direct.
- [AudioTheory Piano Keys](https://audiotheory.co/piano-keys/): AudioTheory Piano Keys gives you audio and visual feedback as you play, with an extensive library of chords and scales — for Mac, Windows and Linux.

## User Guides

- [AudioTheory Grids – User Guide](https://audiotheory.co/grids-user-guide/): The full AudioTheory Grids user guide — the grid, drum grids, the number pad, on-screen piano, scales, the guitar fretboard, settings and audio latency.
- [AudioTheory Guitars – User Guide](https://audiotheory.co/guitars-user-guide/): The full AudioTheory Guitars user guide — getting started, input, playback, scales, chords, the fretboard, settings and audio latency configuration.
- [AudioTheory Piano Keys – User Guide](https://audiotheory.co/piano-keys-user-guide/): The full AudioTheory Piano Keys user guide — input, playback, scales, the scale wheel, piano chords, ear training exercises, settings and audio latency.

- [AudioTheory Guitars 1.15.0 – Auto Load Chords With Scale Update](https://audiotheory.co/updates/auto-load-chords-update/): Auto load a set of chords with each scale preset.
- [AudioTheory Guitars 1.14.0 – Extended Chord Selector Update](https://audiotheory.co/updates/extended-chord-selector-update/): New features to support a larger library of chords.
- [AudioTheory Guitars 1.13.0 – Relative Highlighting Update](https://audiotheory.co/updates/relative-highlighting-update/): Relative sharp and flat highlighting for the fretboard and chords.
- [AudioTheory Grids: Available Now](https://audiotheory.co/updates/audio-theory-grids-release/): AudioTheory Grids releases on Steam, Mac App Store and direct today.
- [AudioTheory Guitars 1.12.0 – Scale Based Highlighting Update](https://audiotheory.co/updates/scale-based-highlighting-update/): The colour coding system is extended to the black keys with scale based highlighting.
- [AudioTheory Guitars 1.11.0 – Diminished 7 Chords Update](https://audiotheory.co/updates/dim7-chords-update/): Dim7 chords with a new selector have been added to the application.
- [AudioTheory Guitars 1.10.0 – Modal Scales Update](https://audiotheory.co/updates/modal-scales-update/): Modal scales, or 'modes' are now part of the fullscreen scale presets.
- [AudioTheory Guitars 1.9.0 – Custom Tuning and Fullscreen Fretboard Update](https://audiotheory.co/updates/custom-tuning-fullscreen-fretboard-update/): A new view mode with a larger fretboard and options to fully configure the guitar tuning.
- [AudioTheory Guitars 1.8.0 – Shifted Tunings Update](https://audiotheory.co/updates/shifted-tunings-update/): Fretboard and chord diagrams for shifted tunings, with an option to lower the 6th string.
- [AudioTheory Guitars 1.7.0 – Exact Chord Playback + Scale Playback Update](https://audiotheory.co/updates/exact-chord-playback-update/): Specific chord note highlighting and audio preview scales.
- [AudioTheory Guitars 1.6.0 – Save and Load Presets Update](https://audiotheory.co/updates/save-load-preset-update/): Quickly swap layouts by saving and loading your configuration.
- [AudioTheory Guitars 1.5.0 – Drop D Tuning + Octave Specific Playback Update](https://audiotheory.co/updates/drop-d-playback-update/): Octave-specific note highlighting and support for Drop D (plus Drop Db) tuning.
- [AudioTheory Guitars 1.4.0 – Fullscreen Scale Selector Update](https://audiotheory.co/updates/fullscreen-scale-selector-update/): Presets for the pentatonic and blues scales plus a fullscreen selector.
- [AudioTheory Guitars 1.3.0 – Power and Barre Chord Update](https://audiotheory.co/updates/power-barre-chord-update/): Barre and power chords are now part of the available chord selection.
- [AudioTheory Guitars 1.2.0 – Fullscreen Chord Selector Update](https://audiotheory.co/updates/fullscreen-chord-selector-update/): View all available chords (with diagrams) from a single screen.
- [AudioTheory Guitars 1.1.0 – Chord & Note Playback Update](https://audiotheory.co/updates/chord-update/): Extended note playback functionality and a play button next to each chord.
